fusions.name: Five-Stroke Drill
fusions.desc: Lashes an enemy within 3.5 tiles, which deals 7 damage and lowers its armour by 6% for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Finding the Seam
fusions.desc: A lash strike that deals 30 damage, always crits, lowers the target's armour by 10% for 6 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Anew
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Corrected Aim
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
